name: LiNKbrain
description: Private Brain adapter for Lisa: durable capture outbox and coordination against Brain Gateway contracts. Default-disabled; fake-only until activation gates.

mcpRead.label: Brain MCP Read
mcpRead.help: When false, no Brain read tools are exposed; native OpenClaw continues.

captureEnqueue.label: Capture Enqueue
captureEnqueue.help: When false, no new capture records are accepted; existing outbox is retained.

captureDrain.label: Capture Drain
captureDrain.help: When false, stop Brain delivery; local durable queue is retained.

coordinationWrites.label: Coordination Writes
coordinationWrites.help: When false, block Brain coordination mutations only.

ingestionCredential.label: Brain Ingestion Credential
ingestionCredential.help: SecretRef or string for the Brain-only ingestion credential. Never paste live secrets into source.

redactionPolicyVersion.label: Redaction Policy Version
redactionPolicyVersion.help: Allowlist redaction policy version applied to internal envelopes before remote writes.

batchMaxEvents.label: Batch Max Events
batchMaxEvents.help: Upper bound on events per capture batch.

batchMaxBytes.label: Batch Max Bytes
batchMaxBytes.help: Upper bound on serialized capture batch size.

outboxMaxEntries.label: Outbox Max Entries
outboxMaxEntries.help: Per-namespace keyed-store capacity with reject-new overflow.

transportMode.label: Transport Mode
transportMode.help: disabled (default), fake (test-only), mcp (managed mcp.servers entry), or http (ingestionEndpoint + SecretRef bearer).

mcpServerName.label: MCP Server Name
mcpServerName.help: Key under mcp.servers for Brain managed MCP. Default linkbrain.

ingestionEndpoint.label: Ingestion Endpoint
ingestionEndpoint.help: HTTP JSON endpoint for Brain writes when transportMode is http.

ingestionEndpoint.description: Brain ingestion endpoint for transportMode=http (SecretRef bearer via ingestionCredential).
